description: This file implements key functions for an advanced networking component related to a simple TCP client, including message reception, sending, and event notification handling. It contains functions for processing application messages, TLS encrypted messages, and event signals in a TCP client context.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscSctoTsaRecvAppMessage(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hMessageBdo)
methods.description: Handles incoming application messages over TCP, copying data from the buffer descriptor to a receive buffer and processing it.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscSctoTsaSendTlsMessage(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hMessageBdo)
methods.description: Sends out a TLS-encapsulated message by transmitting the buffer descriptor content.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscSctoTsaNotifyEvent(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ULONG ulEvent,ULONG ulError,ANSC_HANDLE hEventContext)
methods.description: Handles various connection events such as connection establishment, closure, errors, and timeouts, updating internal state and notifying worker objects accordingly.
